messages:
raj: Heads-up — p95 on /v1/generate spiked ~200ms around 11:23 after we flipped routing to cheaper variant. p50 looks stable.
amanda: saw that, can you paste the query you used?
metrics-bot: ALERT lat_p95_high: latency.p95 > 250ms for endpoint=/v1/generate (11:23 UTC)
raj: here's the ad-hoc query I ran:
```
select p95(latency_ms) from latency where endpoint=\"/v1/generate\" and timeframe=5m group_by route_variant
```
kevin: suspicious — if the console merges tdigest rollups from variants with very different sample counts the blended p95 can be misleading. did you check per-variant sample_count?
luca: checked: variant-cheap cnt=40, p95=260ms; variant-fast cnt=120, p95=180ms. merged p95 ~220ms (not impossible, just higher than the fast variant).
amanda: ok. the problem is UX: console shows only the merged p50/p95 and no obvious sample counts or low-sample hint.
michael: proposal: add an inline sample_count column and grey-out percentiles when count < 100 with a tooltip: "Low sample: percentile unstable". simple and clear.
kevin: or expose aggregation_mode in the query/UI (tdigest|raw|per_variant) so users can toggle. also show both merged and per-variant views by default for rollouts.
raj: quick workaround for anyone hitting this now: in the console query set `group_by=route_variant` — immediate clarity.
amanda: I'm filing a ticket: CORE-UI-2381 — add sample-count column + low-sample greyout + aggregation_mode toggle. @luca can you take ownership?
luca: taking it. will add unit tests for tdigest merge docs and a tiny e2e to surface counts in the table.
metrics-bot: CI: pipeline started for branch ui/CORE-UI-2381 — 3 checks queued
amanda: thanks — also let's add a short runbook note documenting how rollout weight shifts can temporarily push merged p95 up even when the fast variant hasn't regressed.
kevin: +1. I'll draft the runbook blurb and link the ticket.
raj: thanks all, marking the alert as acknowledged. :thumbsup:
